name: Lunar south pole
description: The prepared polar region supports 240 m terrain analysis and hypothetical mission design.
coordinate_note: Geographic pole; longitude zero is a convention, not a physical meridian.

name: Shackleton crater
description: A polar crater within the prepared south-pole analysis footprint.
coordinate_note: USGS Gazetteer displayed center, rounded to 0.01 degree. Navigation aid, not a surveyed engineering site; Gazetteer control networks vary.

name: Lunar north pole
description: Global atlas terrain supports regional analysis and hypothetical placement. Finer prepared polar data is south-pole only; the boundary slope stencil at the exact pole is unavailable.

name: Mare Tranquillitatis / Apollo 11
description: Navigation centered on Statio Tranquillitatis, the Apollo 11 region.
coordinate_note: USGS Gazetteer displayed station center, rounded to 0.01 degree; not the center of the entire mare. Atlas coordinates are navigation aids.

name: Tycho crater
description: Explore a near-side crater using global NASA visualization and coarse LOLA elevation.
coordinate_note: USGS Gazetteer displayed center, rounded; -11.22 degrees east normalized to 348.78. Control-network alternatives are not silently treated as identical.

name: Copernicus crater
description: A near-side destination with global imagery and coarse elevation coverage.
coordinate_note: USGS Gazetteer displayed center, rounded; -20.08 degrees east normalized to 339.92. Navigation precision only.

name: South Pole–Aitken basin
description: A far-side basin overview with global terrain, derived slope and geological interpretation at atlas resolution. Hypothetical missions require explicit illumination profiles.
coordinate_note: Overview center from Petro (2012), figure 1 orthographic projection at 56 degrees south, 180 degrees east. Approximate regional center, not a surveyed point.
